description: Use this when someone wants to know whether specific domain names can be registered and what they cost. Checks up to 20 names (exact domains, or a name plus endings) with the live registrar and returns, for each, whether it can be registered, the first-year and renewal price in USD, and the reason when it cannot. For many names at once, use screen_domains first.

name.description: A name without an ending, e.g. orbitnotes

tlds.description: Endings to try with name, e.g. ["com","ai","dev"]

name: search_domains
title: Search domain availability and price
